'''Rat weed''' is an [[value|inferior]] [[crop]], on the level of [[muck root|muck roots]] and [[prickle berry|prickle berries]]. It can be [[food|eaten raw]], [[cooking|cooked]] or [[brewing|made]] into [[sewer brew]]. However, it is not as [[Alcohol#Types_of_Alcohol|delicious]] as any of the [[underground]] crops.

Rat weed is notable in that it has cookable seeds, providing both food and booze in one cheap item (although strawberries are better if they're also available), and making disposing of their seeds easier if you chose to embark on a biome where farming aboveground crops is impossible.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] rat weed for its ''hanging leaves''.
